> **05:26** · sdh-spot-check low-B extension e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (same spot as run 6), B 0.3->1.5 T uniform-B 4 mT (301 pts), delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 20 uV; pins fan B\_lo; ends at 1.5 T · **ETA ~05:56** (≈30 min)

Picked up after the handoff; runs 6/7 read from disk (ana, next cells). **Run 6 (e, n = +3.2×10¹²):** a strong light tone at **7.2 T** with a harmonic comb (14 / 22 / 29.5 T) and a ~30–31 T tone — against the model at this n (ABAB pair 7.3 / 25.8 T, ABCA singleton 33.1 T) the light tone sits on ABAB's partner and the ~30 T tone is ambiguous (heavy ABAB pocket vs 4×7.2 vs a rescaled singleton). That ambiguity is exactly what the fan's n-dependence screen resolves — **the fan is the next move and goes on the electron side** (the hole side reaches only n = −1.27×10¹², the near-CNP regime where the templates converge; run 7 shows 6.8 T + 12.3 T ≈ F_L there). **Why this 30-min cell first:** `landau-fan` step 1 sets B_lo from `sdh_onset(...).onset_b`, and both spot checks return the light tone as *censored* at the record edge — run 6's 0–1 T leg was 50 mT-stepped (Δ(1/B) ≥ 0.05 T⁻¹ below 1 T, aliased for a 7.2 T tone), so its onset is only bounded: ≤ 1.03 T (window 0.3–4 T read). Each 0.1 T of fan B_lo below 1 T costs ~35 min of fan rows at the fan's Δ(1/B); a 4 mT 0.3 → 1.5 T sweep at the same spot pins it for ~30 min, and doubles as the grid-change reproduction of the 7.2 T tone (4 mT here vs 10 mT in run 6 over 1.0–1.5 T). Sensitivity 20 µV (2 kΩ FS; R ≤ 60 Ω in this window) for a finer ADC step on the ~10 Ω oscillation. **Price:** ramp 0 → 0.3 T (2 min) + 1.2 T traverse (9 min) + 301 pts × 3.1 s (run-6 calibrated per-point overhead, 16 min) ≈ **27 min**; ends at 1.5 T with the gates at the spot, where the fan starts. Checkpoints: first 20 points (sensitivity, leakage, T); the onset read at the end sets the fan cell.

from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)   # run-5 calibration (ana)

assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V")

_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "

assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

B_vec = np.round(np.arange(0.3, 1.5001, 0.004), 4)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP

sr1.sensitivity(20e-6)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T, 4 mT; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s, slope {sr1.filter_slope()} dB (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = f"sdh-spot-check electron low-field extension: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm (run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 0.3 -> 1.5 T, 4 mT, sr1 20 uV"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'electron side LOW-FIELD EXTENSION of run 6 (onset pin for the fan B_lo): n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; '
              f'(Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); B 0.3 -> 1.5 T uniform-B 4 mT; sr1 20 uV; cal run 5')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field ends at 1.5 T — the fan starts from here (ramps down to its B_lo).
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K")
